11wbxt: Original SpanishCue material; the situations and data are for teaching, not real news or official exam texts.
1oo1g68: Differences have been detected between the announced schedules and the actual routes of a bus line. That is how the municipal statement released yesterday begins. The sentence reports a problem, but does not let us know who detected it or how long it lasted. A neighborhood platform had submitted, two weeks earlier, a log of forty trips with delays. The city council confirms that it received that document, although it maintains that not all cases can be attributed to the same cause.
1xlrnro: According to the operating company, roadworks on an avenue forced the route to be modified for five days. The neighborhood logs include later dates, when the works had already ended. This newspaper consulted the service sheets and interviewed three drivers. Two pointed out that vehicles were lacking; the third spoke of difficulties covering some shifts. None authorized the publication of their name. Their testimonies partly coincide, but are not enough to establish how many departures were canceled for each reason.
10r7ts: The councillor's office announced that the data will be reviewed by a technical commission. It did not specify who will be on it or when its conclusions will be published. The platform asks that the previous schedules remain available so changes can be compared, and that each modification be identified with a date. It does not demand a promise of absolute punctuality, but that the information allow people to plan a trip with a reasonable margin of confidence.
ica9hx: While the review is completed, the company has added two services in the highest-demand time slot. This fact was checked against the new schedule and confirmed over two days of observation. It cannot yet be claimed that the measure has solved the general problem. Reporting with caution does not require writing as if events had no one responsible: it requires explaining where each claim comes from, which part has been verified, and which questions remain open. The update to this story will depend on those answers, not just on new statements.
